items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: most of the small jobs, as I said before, Piron used to give me, were just small combos

ctx.x: When you worked out your bass.

The thing about it is that Jules Batiste, he used the bass very much on the guitar, because they always played small combos. Like the fish fry there was two pieces at the Morris, and the guitar just strumming rhythm was much of a support. That bass gave it more of a sound support. And Jules specialized in the bass. And I adopted that style from him, in fact I had taken lessons from him and I adopted his style of playing. And most of the small jobs, as I said before, Piron used to give me, were just small combos,…
Almost like the piano left hand. Exactly.
